classification: Paid sequential simulation with only research prices varied, no battle changes
purchasePolicy: After each settled run repeatedly choose uncapped lowest research level; ties Damage,Supply,Growth,Harvest; wait if selected item is unaffordable. No borrowing or grants. Grown20/20/20/20 has Supply/Growth/Harvest capped, so only Damage can be purchased; initial0 series balances all four.
rewards: Ordinary crystals only; PB milestone excluded
limitations: Same seeds and scenarios reused; not independent populations
Grown studies start at externally supplied20/20/20/20; from-zero series is separate
Running atbudget is censored and receives no reward or purchase
No change to battle rules6 or research multipliers/caps
